responsibility: Declares the extra target options accepted only for bare-metal Nios II ELF toolchains. The file adds command-line switches controlling HAL/BSP linking, alternate C library selection, explicit system library names, and startup file selection, mapping them to target variables and linker-spec behavior consumed by elf.h and the driver-generated option machinery.
same_name_distinction: Unlike elf.h, which implements the ELF bare-metal subtarget policy through specs and target-macro overrides, this .opt file is only the option-definition side of the elf pair: it declares switches such as -msmallc, -msys-lib=, -msys-crt0=, and -mhal for GCC's generated option machinery.
